label: For "Wildfire Ignition Risk Forecasting": Forecast the chance that conditions and equipment could start a fire for each network segment so operators and planners can decide on inspections, covered conductor work and temporary protection settings. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Automated shutoff decisions.
